chapterInfo.content:
16
Hiob su frɛ Onyankopɔn
1Na Hiob gyee so sɛ:
2Mate saa nsɛm a ɛte sɛɛ bebree;
mo nyinaa moyɛ gyamserefoɔ.
3Nsɛnhuuhuu yi awieeɛ nie?
Anaasɛ ɛdeɛn na ɛhwanyan wo ma wobua?
4 # Dwom 22.7 Sɛ mo wɔ me tebea mu a,
anka me nso mɛkasa sɛ mo,
anka mɛhɔre nsɛm magu mo so,
na mawoso me ti magu mo so;
5aane, anka mede m’ano bɛhyɛ mo den,
na m’anomu duema ama mo yea aboto.
6Sɛ mekasa a, me yea no mmoto,
na sɛ megyae nso a, ɛdeɛn na ɛfiri me ho korɔ?
7Na afei deɛ, Onyankopɔn ahodwo me;
woama me ho nnipa nyinaa agu;
8woapompono me ama no adane adanseɛ,
na me fɔn asɔre atia me atoto m’ano wɔ m’anim.
9 # Dwom 35.16; 112.10 Wasunsuane me n’abufuo mu, na ɔtaa me;
ɔtwɛre ne se gu me so.
M’ahohiahiafoɔ no pɔkyere n’ani hwɛ me.
10 # Dwom 22.7 Wɔhaahaa wɔn anomu tia me,
wɔde ahohorabɔ bobɔ m’aso mu,
wɔn nyinaa boaboa wɔn ano tia me.
11Onyankopɔn ayi me ahyɛ abusufoɔ nsa,
na wasum me ato abɔnefoɔ nsam.
12 # Kwa 3.12 Anka medi yie, na ɔbubuu me.
Ɔsɔɔ me kɔn na ɔbubuu me pasaa,
na ɔde me sii hɔ yɛɛ ne botaeɛ;
13n’agyan dii me so ntwaguo,
ɔpaee me sawa mu, na wannodo ho,
ɔhwiee me bɔnwoma guu fam;
14Ɔbubuu me mprɛ bebree,
ɔto baa me so sɛ ɔdɔmmanin.
15 # Gye 37.34 Mepam ayitoma mekataa me wedeɛ so,
na mede m’ahoɔden too mfuturo mu.
16Esu nti m’ani abere kɔkɔkɔkɔ,
na owuo sunsum da m’anisuatɛtɛ so.
17Nanso amim biara nni me nsam,
na me mpaebɔ ho te.
18 # Gye 4.10 O! Asase, nkata me mogya so,
na mma me sufrɛ nnnya homebea!
19Seesei mpo, hwɛ, ɔsoro na me danseni wɔ,
na me dimafoɔ wɔ deɛ ɛkorɔn.
20 # Kwa 3.14 Me nnamfo mpo di me ho fɛw,
nanso Onyankopɔn na m’ani porepore nisuo ma no.
21Sɛ ɔnni mma onipa wɔ Nyankopɔn anim,
sɛdeɛ onipa ba di ma ne yɔnko no.
22 # Hiob 10.21 Na mfeɛ a ɛwɔ ano no bɛdu
na makɔ kwan a merensane memma.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
